components.css: .ds-plate{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:320px;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:9999px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,white,var(--color-loza) 55%,oklch(0.95 0.015 85));box-shadow:0 2px 3px oklch(0.3 0.02 230 / 0.15),0 30px 50px -24px oklch(0.3 0.02 230 / 0.4),inset 0 2px 1px oklch(1 0 0)}.ds-well{position:absolute;inset:8.5%;border-radius:9999px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,oklch(0.945 0.012 85),var(--color-loza) 65%);box-shadow:inset 0 5px 14px oklch(0.3 0.02 230 / 0.2),inset 0 -2px 3px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.9),0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0)}.ds-plate-in{position:relative;padding:0 24px;text-align:center}.ds-plate-l{margin:0;font:500 14px var(--font-sans,'Instrument Sans',system-ui,sans-serif);color:var(--color-tinta-suave)}.ds-plate-g{margin:12px 0;font:400 36px/1.15 var(--font-display,'DM Serif Display',Georgia,serif);color:var(--color-terracota-hondo)}.ds-dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px}.ds-dots i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:9999px;background:oklch(0.74 0.05 160 / 0.6)}.ds-dots i.on{background:var(--color-mostaza)}

narrative.overview:
The world is a ceramic plate on a stone counter, and it lends four things only: a warm display serif against a humanist sans, a palette of stone, glazed white, slate and terracotta, generous air with very round corners, and one signature move. It does not lend layout, navigation or controls. Those stay standard web: a 64px header with a step indicator, a 7/5 split, real radios, a real select, real tabs.

The signature is the plate: a round glazed plate with a sunken well that reads the visitor's goal back in terracotta serif as they choose, with seven dots for the days of the week. Six glazed cards below it hold the other answers. When a value changes it is "glazed" in with one short vertical wipe. On the plan page the same plate heads the plan. Everything else is quiet: surfaces have no border, depth comes from soft offset-and-blur shadows, buttons are pills.
keyCharacteristics: Borderless surfaces; soft shadows carry all depth.
Serif voice for the wordmark, headings, day and meal names and the plate goal; sans for everything read or typed.
Terracotta fills the one primary action; slate marks selection and focus.
State is never colour alone: Check plus fill for selected, icon plus text for errors, underline for the current step.
One motion moment: the repaint wipe.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Terracotta fills only the primary action. Errors use deep terracotta as a 2px ring and as text with an icon, never as a fill.

rules.name: The Contrast Pair Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is a fill (white text on it); deep terracotta is the text colour on stone or glaze. Do not swap them.

rules.name: The Dots Only Rule
rules.body: Mustard and celadon appear in the week dots (and mustard as selection highlight). They are never a button, card or text colour.

rules.name: The Serif Names Rule
rules.body: DM Serif Display appears only on the wordmark, headings, meal and day names, and the plate goal. Never on buttons, labels, form text or body.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any figure the reader compares (inputs, tile values, sets and reps, the stepper numbers) is set `tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is ink-tinted, blurred and offset downward; never a solid offset, never black. Surfaces carry no border.

rules.name: The Plate Glaze Rule
rules.body: The plate's two subtle glaze gradients (a white-to-glaze radial on the rim, a stone-to-glaze linear in the well) belong to the plate and its relief. No other surface gets a gradient.

dos: Do keep depth to the four ink-tinted shadows (loza, tarjeta, plato, pozo) and leave surfaces borderless.
Do use pills for buttons and tabs, 16px for controls and tiles, 24px for large cards.
Do use deep terracotta for terracotta text and error rings; terracotta only as the primary fill.
Do pair every state colour with an icon, weight or text change.
Do add new colours in `@theme` as oklch in the same warm-stone family; gate any new animated value behind `data-live` and a reduced-motion override.
Do keep touch targets at 48px (44px for tabs) and figures tabular.
donts: Don't add borders, hard offset shadows, 900 weights or thick outlines; the world rejects the neobrutalist look.
Don't put mustard or celadon anywhere but the week dots and the text selection.
Don't set the serif on buttons, labels, form text or body, and don't bold it.
Don't convey a state with colour alone.
Don't fall back to the category default: white card with a gradient, an "AI" badge.
Don't repaint on first paint or add other entrance animation.
